out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HANDWASHING SINK NEAR THE BAR NOT WORKING.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC INFORMED THE EHS THE ESTABLISHMENT HAS CONTACTED A TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR THE SINK. PLEASE PROVIDE THE EHS WITH PROOF THAT THE SINK HAS BEEN REPAIRED WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: OBSERVED THE BAR DISHWASHING MACHINE NOT SANITIZING AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC UNDERSTANDS THE BAR DISHWASHING MACHINE. SHOULD NOT BE USED UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED AND CAN PROPERLY SANITIZE BETWEEN 50-200PPM.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED PARTIALLY COOKED STEAK IN BOTH PREP TOP COOLERS.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. EHS DISCUSSED REQUIREMENTS OF NON-CONTINUOUS COOKING PROCESS WITH THE PIC. PIC HAS AGREED TO DISCONTINUE NON-CONTINUOUS COOKING PROCESS AND FULLY COOK THE STEAK IN ONE COOK STEP.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED CHICKEN AND STEAK PARTIALLY COOKED IN BOTH PREP-TOPS AT THE COOK-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. EHS DISCUSSED NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS REQUIREMENTS WITH THE PIC. THE FACILITY HAS AGREED TO DISCONTINUE THE PROCESS. IF THE FACILITY WOULD LIKE TO DO A NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS IN THE FUTURE, PLEASE CONTACT THE. EHS TO DISCUSS NECESSARY DOCUMENTATION.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED THAWING COMMERCIALLY VACUUM PACKAGED SALMON IN A TWO DOOR PREP TOP IN INTACT PACKAGE.
violations.corrective_action: PIC SLIT OPEN PACKAGES DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAWING FISH THAT IS COMMERCIALLY VACUUM PACKAGED MUST BE REMOVED FROM PACKAGING OR THE PACKAGE MUST BE SLIT OPEN WHEN THE THAWING PROCESS BEGINS. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF ARE INFORMED TO CUT THE BAG/REMOVE FISH FROM THE BAG.
